summary: Vistra Operations Company LLC filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of two series of junior subordinated notes due 2057, irrevocably guaranteed by Vistra Corp. Series A resets in 2032 and Series B in 2037, each to a five-year Treasury rate plus a spread, with a floor equal to the initial rate, semi-annual interest from March 2027, a 10-year interest deferral right, and optional redemption. Amounts, coupons, and spreads are blank. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing, tenor, and deferral terms.
